issues.detail: The Hebrew lists the sons of Jeduthun as גְּדַלְיָהוּ (Gedaliah), צְרִי (Zeri), יְשַׁעְיָהוּ (Jeshaiah), חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ (Hashabiah), and מַתִּתְיָהוּ (Mattithiah). The Chinese renders the second name as '乳香膏樹' (a plant name, 'frankincense ointment tree'), which is not a personal name and does not correspond to 'Zeri' (צְרִי). This is a mistranslation of a proper name.

The first name גְּדַלְיָהוּ (Gedaliah) is rendered as '耶大亞' (Yeda'ya), which is not the standard transliteration of Gedaliah and appears to be a different name (possibly a confusion with יְדָיָה or similar). This constitutes a name swap.
